user.text:
I want a small app for keeping track of the books I'm reading.

When I open it I want to see what I'm currently reading and what I've finished. I want to add a book from a form, mark one as finished, and click through to a book to see its title, author and my notes. I'd like to be able to send someone a link to a single book.

Nothing fancy and no accounts. Skip the database, save the books to a JSON file so they're still there after a restart.

history.assistant:
The book tracker is ready. Run `npm start` and open http://localhost:3000.

The home page lists what you are currently reading and what you have finished. Add a book with the form, mark one finished from the list or its page, and click a title to see the title, author, and notes. You can update notes on that page. Each book has its own link, shown in the Share box, such as http://localhost:3000/books/that-id.

There are no accounts. Books are stored in `data/books.json` and stay there after a restart.

`npm test` passed, exit code 0, 5 tests. A live check on port 3456 confirmed adding a book, opening its link, marking it finished, and saving that to the JSON file. The sample book was removed, so the list starts empty.
